product_overview: The product provides secure authentication and self-service account recovery, plus administrative management of users, roles, permissions, pages, and data scope. It also includes dashboard navigation and mock local-state organization and notifications modules for managing related business data.
core_goals: Allow users to sign in, register, activate accounts, and reset forgotten passwords
Enable administrators to manage users, roles, permissions, and application pages
Support role-based page permissions and data-scope assignment by branch
Provide access to user profiles and branch-scoped access settings
Let authenticated users navigate to dashboard, organization, and notifications areas

features.name: Authentication and Self-Service
features.description: Public access flows for login, signup, account activation, password recovery, password reset, and logout.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Fill in username -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See dashboard
Navigate to / -> Switch to signup tab -> Fill in username, email, and password -> Submit signup form -> See account created with disabled status
Navigate to / -> Switch to activate tab -> Fill in activation token -> Submit activation form -> See account activated
Navigate to / -> Switch to forgot password tab -> Fill in email -> Submit password reset request -> See confirmation message
Navigate to / -> Switch to reset password tab -> Fill in OTP token and new password -> Submit reset form -> See password updated
Navigate to / -> Fill in username and password -> Submit login form with invalid credentials -> See error message

features.name: User Management
features.description: Administrative management of user accounts, including search, filtering, creation, editing, deletion, role assignment, enabled status changes, and access to profile and data-scope drawers.
user_flows: Navigate to /security/users -> Search users by keyword -> Filter users by status -> See matching results
Navigate to /security/users -> Open user creation -> Fill in user details -> Submit create form -> See new user in the list
Navigate to /security/users -> Open a user for editing -> Change user fields -> Save changes -> See updated user details
Navigate to /security/users -> Open a user for editing -> Select roles -> Save changes -> See updated role assignments
Navigate to /security/users -> Disable or enable a user -> See the user status change in the list
Navigate to /security/users -> Delete a user -> Confirm deletion -> See the user removed from the list
Navigate to /security/users -> Open a user for editing -> Open user profile drawer -> Edit profile details -> Save profile -> See updated profile data
Navigate to /security/users -> Open a user for editing -> Open data scope drawer -> Select branch access scope -> Save data scope -> See updated scope assignment

features.name: Role Management and RBAC
features.description: Administrative management of roles, page permissions, activation state, permission matrix editing, and permission copying between roles.
user_flows: Navigate to /security/roles -> Search and filter roles by status -> See matching roles
Navigate to /security/roles -> Open role creation -> Fill in role details -> Submit create form -> See new role in the list
Navigate to /security/roles -> Open a role for editing -> Change role details -> Save changes -> See updated role information
Navigate to /security/roles -> Open a role for editing -> Toggle page-level create, update, and delete permissions -> Save changes -> See updated permission matrix
Navigate to /security/roles -> Open a role for editing -> Sync all page permissions -> See the role permissions replaced
Navigate to /security/roles -> Open a role for editing -> Copy permissions from another role -> Confirm copy -> See copied page permissions applied
Navigate to /security/roles -> Open a role -> Deactivate the role -> Confirm deactivation -> See the role marked inactive
Navigate to /security/roles -> Open a role -> Reactivate the role -> Confirm reactivation -> See the role marked active
Navigate to /security/roles -> Open a role for editing -> Remove a page from the role -> See the page removed from the permission matrix
Navigate to /security/users -> Open a user for editing -> Open data scope drawer -> Assign branch access to a role -> Save data scope -> See the role branch scope updated

features.name: Permission Registry
features.description: Administrative creation and editing of raw permission records, with search and module filtering.
user_flows: Navigate to /security/permissions -> Search permissions by keyword -> Filter permissions by module -> See matching permissions
Navigate to /security/permissions -> Open permission creation -> Fill in permission details -> Submit create form -> See new permission in the list
Navigate to /security/permissions -> Open a permission for editing -> Change the permission name -> Save changes -> See updated permission name

features.name: Page Registry
features.description: Administrative management of application pages, including creation, editing, deactivation, and reactivation of page entries.
user_flows: Navigate to /security/pages -> Search pages by keyword -> Filter pages by module and status -> See matching pages
Navigate to /security/pages -> Open page creation -> Fill in page code, names, route, and metadata -> Submit create form -> See new page in the list
Navigate to /security/pages -> Open a page for editing -> Change page details -> Save changes -> See updated page information
Navigate to /security/pages -> Deactivate a page -> Confirm deactivation -> See the page marked inactive
Navigate to /security/pages -> Reactivate a page -> Confirm reactivation -> See the page marked active

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Authenticated landing page showing KPI cards and quick navigation to major modules.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View KPI summary cards -> Open quick navigation to Security, Organization, or Notifications -> Reach the selected module
Navigate to /dashboard -> Open file attachments demo -> See the attachment drawer

features.name: Organization Management
features.description: Mock local-state CRUD screens for legal entities, branches, regions, departments, cost centers, profit centers, and locations.
user_flows: Navigate to /organization/legal-entities -> Create, edit, or delete a legal entity -> See the list update locally
Navigate to /organization/branches -> Create, edit, or deactivate a branch -> Confirm the action -> See the branch update locally
Navigate to /organization/regions -> Create, edit, or delete a region -> See the list update locally
Navigate to /organization/departments -> Expand or collapse the department tree -> Create, edit, or delete a department -> See the tree update locally
Navigate to /organization/cost-centers -> Expand or collapse the cost center tree -> Create, edit, or delete a cost center -> See the tree update locally
Navigate to /organization/profit-centers -> Create, edit, or delete a profit center -> See the list update locally
Navigate to /organization/locations -> Create, edit, or delete a location site -> See the list update locally

features.name: Notifications
features.description: Mock local-state inbox, template, and channel management for viewing and configuring notifications.
user_flows: Navigate to /notifications/inbox -> Search or filter notifications by type and status -> See matching notifications
Navigate to /notifications/inbox -> Mark a notification as read -> See its read status change
Navigate to /notifications/inbox -> Mark all notifications as read -> See the inbox update
Navigate to /notifications/inbox -> Archive a notification -> See it removed from the active inbox
Navigate to /notifications/templates -> Create a notification template -> Edit EN/AR body content -> Save template -> See the template in the list
Navigate to /notifications/channels -> Toggle a notification channel on or off -> Confirm the change -> See the channel state update
Navigate to /notifications/channels -> Edit JSON channel configuration -> Save changes -> See the updated configuration

tech_stack: TanStack React Query 5 (server state / data fetching)
Custom fetch-based HTTP client with 401 refresh-retry and CSRF header
No router library (in-app screen switch via Zustand navigation store, no URL routing)
Custom UI primitives (no MUI/AntD), Tabler icon webfont

routes.description: Login screen shown whenever the user is not authenticated (tabs for login, signup, activate account, forgot password, reset password)
Landing screen after login; KPI summary cards and module quick-navigation
User management - list, search, filter, create, edit, delete users; assign roles
Role management - list, create, edit, activate/deactivate roles; per-role CRUD permission matrix; copy permissions between roles
Permission registry - list, search/filter, create and edit permissions (no delete)
Page registry management - list, create, edit, deactivate/reactivate application pages/menu entries
Legal entities CRUD (mock/local state only, not backed by a real API)
Branches CRUD with deactivate confirmation (mock/local state only)
Departments CRUD with tree view (mock/local state only)
Cost centers CRUD with tree view (mock/local state only)
Notification inbox - search/filter, mark as read, mark all as read, archive (mock/local state only)
Notification template CRUD, EN/AR body tabs (mock/local state only)
Notification channel enable/disable toggles with JSON config editor (mock/local state only)

known_limitations.issue: No URL-based routing; navigation is an in-memory Zustand screen switch with no deep-linking or browser back/forward support
known_limitations.impact: Tests cannot navigate via URL; must drive navigation through in-app clicks (sidebar/menu)

known_limitations.issue: No per-screen/per-permission authorization guard is implemented; only a single global isAuthenticated check gates the whole app
known_limitations.impact: Any authenticated user can reach every screen regardless of assigned role/permissions

known_limitations.issue: Organization module (Legal Entities, Branches, Regions, Departments, Cost Centers, Profit Centers, Locations) is entirely mock/local state
known_limitations.impact: Create/update/delete only mutate in-memory state and are lost on page refresh; no backend persistence

known_limitations.issue: Notifications module (Inbox, Templates, Channels) is entirely mock/local state
known_limitations.impact: All actions (mark read, archive, template/channel CRUD) only mutate in-memory state, not persisted

known_limitations.issue: useSecurityStore (mock data) is legacy and only used by Dashboard KPI counts while Users/Roles pages use real API data
known_limitations.impact: Dashboard KPI counts for users/roles can be inconsistent with the actual data shown on the Users/Roles pages

known_limitations.issue: Branch ID type mismatch between mock Organization store (string slugs) and real Security APIs (numeric IDs), bridged via a regex-strip hack
known_limitations.impact: Branch selection in profile/data-scope drawers depends on a fragile numeric-extraction workaround pending real Organization API integration

known_limitations.issue: Permissions registry has no delete capability (no backend delete endpoint)
known_limitations.impact: Permissions can only be created or renamed, never removed from the UI

known_limitations.issue: Role status filter is applied client-side only on the currently loaded page of results, not the full dataset
known_limitations.impact: Filtering by status may appear incomplete when results span multiple pages

known_limitations.issue: No automated test files exist in the project and no ESLint config; the "lint" script only runs tsc type-checking
known_limitations.impact: No prior test coverage baseline exists for TestSprite to compare against
